sanskrit: agnis takmānam apa bādhatām itaḥ somo grāvā marutaḥ pūtadakṣāḥ | vedir barhiḥ samidhaḥ śośucānā apa rakṣāṃsy amuyā dhamantu ||
english: May Agni drive the fever away from here; may Soma, the pressing-stones, and the Maruts of pure might — may the vedi, the barhis, and the blazing kindling-sticks blow the demons away by that same power.

sanskrit: ayaṃ yo ruro abhiśocayiṣṇur viśvā rūpāṇi haritā kṛṇoti | tasmai te 'ruṇāya babhrave tapur maghāya namo 'stu takmane ||
english: This one — the Ruru who burns with scorching heat, who renders all forms yellow-green — to him, to you, O Takman, the tawny, the reddish-brown, the fervid, the mighty: homage be!

sanskrit: takman sārthinam icchasva vaśī san mṛḍayāsi naḥ | athehi yatra te gṛhā aninūrtteṣu dasyuṣu ||
english: Seek out a travelling companion, O Takman, and being thus appeased, show us mercy! Come now — go to where your dwelling-places are, among the never-satiated Dasyus.

sanskrit: yaḥ puruṣaḥ pāruṣeyo 'vadhvaṃsa ivāruṇaḥ | takmānaṃ viśvadhāvīrya- -adharāñcaṃ parā suva ||
english: The man who is speckled, reddish like one covered in blemishes — the all-powerful fever, drive it downward and away!

sanskrit: adharāñcaṃ pra hiṇomi manas kṛtvā takmane | śakambharasya muṣṭihā punar gaccha mahāvṛṣān ||
english: Downward I dispatch it, turning my mind toward the fever. O destroyer of Śakambhara, go back again to the great Vṛṣas!

sanskrit: mahāvṛṣān mūjavata oka edhi paretya | vratāni takmane brūmo anyakṣetrāṇi vā imāḥ ||
english: Go, having departed, to the Mahāvṛṣas, to the Mūjavats — make that your home! We declare vows for Takman: these are other territories for him.

sanskrit: oko asya mūjavanta oko asya mahāvṛṣāḥ | yāj jātas takmaṃ tād asi balihikeṣu nyocaraḥ ||
english: The Mūjavats are his home; the Mahāvṛṣas are his home. By that people among whom you, O Takman, were born, among those Balihikas you shall roam below!

sanskrit: takman vyāla vigada vyaṅga bhūri yāvaya | dāsīṃ niṣṭakvarīm iccha tāṃ vajreṇa sam arpaya ||
english: O Takman, ward off the serpent, the tongueless one, the lame — drive them far away! Seek out the slovenly slave-woman; pierce her through with your thunderbolt!

sanskrit: giriṃ gaccha girijāsi girau te māhiṣo gṛhaḥ | dāsīm iccha prapharvyaṃ tāṃ takman vīva dhūnuhi ||
english: Go to the mountain — you are mountain-born; in the mountain your buffalo's home lies! Seek out the coarse slave-woman; shake her violently, O Takman, like a reed!

sanskrit: yas tvaṃ śīto atho rūraḥ saha kāsāvīviyaḥ | bhimās te takman hetayas tābhi sma pari vṛṅdhi naḥ ||
english: You who are the chill, and also the fierce burning, together with your cough: your dreadful missiles, O Takman — with those, do encompass and wound us not!

sanskrit: takman bhrātrā balāsena svasrā kāsikayā saha | pāmnā bhrātṛvyeṇa naśyeto maraṭāṅ abhi ||
english: O Takman, together with your brother Balāsa and your sister Kāsikā, and with Pāman your kinsman-rival — vanish utterly, both of you, toward the Maraṭas!

sanskrit: gandhāribhyo mūjavadbhyaḥ kāśibhyo magadhebhyaḥ | jane priyam iva śevadhiṃ takmānaṃ pari dadhmasi ||
english: To the Gandhāris, to the Mūjavats, to the Kāśis, to the Māgadhas — we pass along Takman as one passes a dear treasure to the people!

sanskrit: nārkavindān nārvidālān nānnadīṃ vartakāvatīm | vratāni takmane brūmo anyakṣetrāṇi vā imāḥ ||
english: Not among the Arkavindas, not among the Arvidālas, not among the quail-haunted river Annadī — we declare the vows for Takman: these are other territories for him.

sanskrit: anyakṣetre na ramate sahasrākṣo amartyaḥ | abhūd u prārthas takmā sa gamiṣyati balihikām ||
english: The thousand-eyed immortal one takes no delight in another's territory. Takman has now been duly sought — he will go to the Balihikā!

sanskrit: ado gaccha mūjavatas tato vā gha parastaram | mā smāto abhyair naḥ punas tat tvā takmann upa bruve ||
english: Go to yonder Mūjavats, or yet farther beyond them! Do not come back to us again from there — this I speak to you, O Takman!

sanskrit: parasmaiva tvaṃ cara paramasyāṃ parāvati | yathā no nāntam āyasi yathā no nābhiśocayā ||
english: Roam only to the beyond, in the farthest of far regions — so that you may not come to our end, so that you may not burn us again!

sanskrit: yatheyam urvī pṛthivī vṛddhaiva garbham ādadhe | evā dadhāmi te garbhaṃ tasmai tvām avase huve ||
english: As this broad Pṛthivī, like a mature woman, has taken the embryo to herself — so I place the embryo in you; to that end I invoke you for your protection.

sanskrit: parvatād divo yoner gātrād gātrāt samāśṛtam | reto devasya devasya tsarau parṇam ivā dhām ||
english: Gathered from the mountain, from the womb of heaven, limb by limb — the seed of the god upon god I have set, like a leaf on a bough.

sanskrit: viṣṇur yoniṃ kalpayatu tvaṣṭā rupāṇi piṃśatu | ā siñcatu prajāpatir dhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te ||
english: May Viṣṇu prepare the womb; may Tvaṣṭṛ fashion the forms; may Prajāpati pour in the seed; may Dhātṛ place the embryo in you.

sanskrit: garbhaṃ dhehi sinīvāli garbhaṃ dhehi sarasvati | garbhaṃ yuvam aśvināsyāmā dhattaṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: Place the embryo, O Sinīvālī; place the embryo, O Sarasvatī! O Aśvins, you two wreathed with lotuses, place the embryo in her here and now!

sanskrit: garbhaṃ te rājā varuṇo garbhaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ | garbhaṃ ta indraś cāgniś ca garbhaṃ dhātā dadhātu te ||
english: May King Varuṇa place the embryo in you; may the god Bṛhaspati; may Indra and Agni place the embryo in you; may Dhātṛ place the embryo in you.

sanskrit: garbho asy oṣadhīnāṃ garbho vanaspatīnām | garbho viśvasya bhūtasya so agne garbham eha dhāḥ ||
english: You are the embryo of the herbs; you are the embryo of the forest-lords; you are the embryo of all that exists — so, O Agni, place the embryo here!

sanskrit: yenauṣadhayo garbhinīḥ paśavo yena garbhinaḥ | teṣāṃ garbhasya yo garbhas tena tvaṃ garbhiṇī bhava ||
english: That by which the herbs become pregnant, that by which the beasts become pregnant — by that embryo of their embryos, may you become pregnant!

sanskrit: vi te granthiṃ cṛtāmasi dhātā garbhaṃ dadhātu te | ā yoniṃ putro rohatu jananaṃ prati jāyatām ||
english: We cut loose your knot; may Dhātṛ place the embryo in you. Let a son mount into the womb; let him be born to birth!

sanskrit: janiṣṭa hi mahiyā ā yoniṃ sam ihāsarat | athā soma iva bhakṣaṇam ā garbhaḥ sīdatv ṛtviyam ||
english: For she shall give birth in her greatness — the womb has come together here. Now, like Soma readied for drinking, may the embryo settle in its proper season!

sanskrit: dhātaḥ śreṣṭhena rūpeṇa- -asyā nāryā gavīnyoḥ | pumāṃsaṃ putram ā dhehi daśame māsi sūtave ||
english: O Dhātṛ, with your finest form — in the two birth-passages of this woman — place a male son, to be delivered in the tenth month!
